Strategy: Scale both the sweet-band reward and the mid penalty up to twenty-five, testing whether firmer steering beats Best Fit more clearly. This sharpens the preference for reusable leftovers, but the larger adjustments may override tight fits that Best Fit would choose well.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (25 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
